Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Join an international team developing cloud-based applications for managing next-generation networking solutions. You'll work on scalable, high-performance distributed systems, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with experienced engineers in an Agile environment.
 💼 What You'll Do
 ✅ Design, develop, and enhance backend services using Go
 ✅ Participate in architecture discussions and code reviews
 ✅ Build and maintain scalable cloud-native applications
 ✅ Work with Kubernetes and containerized environments
 ✅ Develop and integrate APIs using OpenAPI and gRPC
 ✅ Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/SCRUM setup
 ✅ Participate in requirements analysis, estimation, and sprint planning
 ✅ Drive technical excellence and contribute to development best practices
 🎯 What We're Looking For
 ✔ Strong experience with Go development
 ✔ Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container technologies
 ✔ Experience designing and consuming APIs using OpenAPI and gRPC
 ✔ Strong knowledge of distributed and scalable systems
 ✔ Experience with PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis
 ✔ Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
 ✔ Familiarity with GitHub and modern software development practices
 ✔ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 ✔ Experience working in Agile environments
 ⭐ Nice to Have
 ➕ Experience with Apache Flink and Telegraf
 ➕ Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, TeamCity, or similar platforms
 ➕ Experience working in enterprise-scale environments
 ➕ Passion for building reliable and high-performance systems
 🌟 Why Apply?
 ✨ Work on large-scale cloud-native applications
 ✨ Modern technology stack and challenging technical projects
 ✨ International and collaborative environment
 ✨ Opportunity to influence architecture and technical decisions
 ✨ Professional development and long-term career growth
